original_package_input.name: 既有 WORK 的施工連續性
original_package_input.observable_outcome: Raw Plan／v9 Companion 到既有 Compiler 的有界 Adapter、能力／成本、Executor 切換、Trusted Context、STOP／Resume。
original_package_input.backend_scope: Python owns application/domain/economic state and persistence through existing ports; BFF owns auth/workflow/proxy only. Unit proposed paths must be compiled to exact current allowlist.
original_package_input.frontend_scope: PK11 consumes exact pinned API/DTO/error/permission contracts; other packages supply domain fixtures and state/effect semantics. No browser SQL/Broker authority.
original_package_input.integration_boundary: Contract-first one canonical operation/model source. Contract tests compare Python/OpenAPI/BFF/React models; interface changes require controlled revision and impacted consumer closure.
original_package_input.executor_capability: Actual implementation language/toolchain + domain risk + exact source/context comprehension + positive/negative/concurrency test ability; named tool alone is not qualification.
original_package_input.targeted_tests: Use every listed Unit case/fixture and targeted command proposal after actual repository placement; proposals are requirements, not actual results.
original_package_input.integration_tests: Pinned producer→consumer DTO/domain/persistence tests, error/retry/unknown/idempotency/CAS and relevant UI actions. Isolated actual PG only under separate grant.
original_package_input.regression_tests: Changed source/contract/dependency closure only; protect accepted predecessors. Full B3 same-version journey at PK12 and formal release; no blanket 216-schema rerun for display-only change.
original_package_input.human_visual_gate: Affected interactive UI state, layout, keyboard/error/conflict/recovery/authority display reviewed on actual browser; no visual acceptance inferred from API tests.
original_package_input.writer_worktree_strategy: Planning/readonly branches may coexist. No worktree is created here. Exact disjoint file scopes, one writer per scope, scoped grants, dependency cuts and integration owner required before parallel implementation. Current WORK NO_PARALLEL_EXECUTION retained until lawfully scoped successor/profile permits concurrent executions.
original_package_input.context_policy: Load exact Unit + v9 head/companion + required pairs + minimal producer/consumer closure. Raw provenance retained separately; required source cannot be truncated. R06 current-profile qualification required where used.

cost_and_eta.reason: No comparable exact implementation cohort; existing WORK forecasts cost before lawful compile and records actual producer evidence.

original_package_input.entry_gate: Human A+B adopted scope + existing Owner materialized receipt/fresh re-entry; approved compiler companion adapter/context profile; exact source/preimages/protected scope/dependency results/current capacity/one-writer/grant remain required before execution
original_package_input.done_and_next_gate: Per-unit actual evidence→required independent verification→existing WORK Intake; only credited accepted units count once. Package complete does not close P00 or enable runtime.
original_package_input.closed_schema_adaptation: HOLD_DIRECT_SUBMISSION: PK labels do not match closed p00.package.v1 PXX identity; use accepted unit companion/approved adapter profile through existing Owner, never coerce IDs or extend a closed schema in place
original_package_input.write_scope_status: NO_EXECUTABLE_ALLOWLIST_GRANTED; member proposed paths are inputs for later current-blob source assembly
